title: Lab - Troubleshoot the network
description: Fix a cluster whose networking is broken in two places.
scenario: Fix a cluster whose networking is broken in two places. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - CNI
tasks.instructions: Pods are stuck ContainerCreating. Is a CNI installed? Install one.

tasks.title: Task 2 - kube-proxy
tasks.instructions: Services do not route. Check the kube-proxy DaemonSet and its config path.
tasks.solution:
kubectl logs -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-proxy
kubectl edit ds -n kube-system kube-proxy  # fix the --config path

tasks.title: Task 3 - DNS
tasks.instructions: Names do not resolve. Check CoreDNS and the kube-dns Service.
tasks.solution:
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns
kubectl get svc -n kube-system kube-dns
